subject: SMALLEST-ALGEBRAIC function
notes: Citation validated: cite.py --check 15.83.3 'Argument-1 shall be a data item of category numeric' -> OK (rule 1). Editions 2023 derived from cite.py --check E.3.3 'The SMALLEST-ALGEBRAIC intrinsic function has been added to provide the smallest number' -> OK (item 29), NOT from the catalog row. Governing code READ: IntrinsicBinder.cs#BindAlgebraicFold, reached from BindIntrinsicCore's Fold dispatch (sig.Bind == IntrinsicBind.Fold && sig.Name is SMALLEST/HIGHEST/LOWEST-ALGEBRAIC). All THREE halves of r1 are enforced there. (a) DATA ITEM: the argument must bind as a BoundFieldOperand whose Place is not a RefModPlace, whose Item is not a group, and which carries a PicInfo -- a literal, an arithmetic expression, a group, a ref-modified item and a nested intrinsic (which arrives either as a BoundComputedOperand or, for the folding intrinsics LENGTH / BYTE-LENGTH / *-ALGEBRAIC, as a BoundNumLiteral) all fall through to AlgebraicArgError -> COBOL1516 quoting r1's own words. (b) CATEGORY NUMERIC: 'pic.Category is not PicCategory.Numeric && !(edited && sig.Name != SMALLEST-ALGEBRAIC)' -- numeric-edited is refused for SMALLEST specifically, which is right: r1 is STRICTER than the 15.43.3 / 15.58.3 twins that admit numeric-edited. USAGE INDEX is refused by its own test (class index, not category numeric). (c) NOT AN INTEGER OR NUMERIC FUNCTION: a user-defined function result binds to a synthesized caller temp that wears BoundFieldOperand exactly like declared data, so the positive is-a-declared-item test DataItem.IsCompilerTemp draws COBOL1516 citing 15.83.3 r1 (kb/Work R26, landed). The two ADMITTED cases before the field-operand pattern are correct rather than holes: BoundLinageCounterRef / BoundReportCounterRef fold to 1 because 8.5.2.12 items 3/4/5 make LINAGE-/LINE-/PAGE-COUNTER category-numeric DATA ITEMS. Cross-checked the screening path: IntrinsicArgumentRules.Verified deliberately carries NO schema row for SMALLEST-ALGEBRAIC (its reason string at IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs:776 records that BindAlgebraicFold owns r1 in full incl. the data-item half a class screen cannot express), and CheckArgumentClasses returns early for a name absent from Verified (IntrinsicBinder.cs:1659) -- so there is exactly ONE mechanism, and it is the complete one. Tests: Algebraic_LiteralArgument_1516 pins the literal rejection citing 15.83.3 r1; goldens 2023/intrinsics_smallest_algebraic and 2023/algebraic_counter_registers pin the accepted data-item and register forms. The function-result half is pinned only through the sibling (negative/algebraic-udf-argument uses HIGHEST-ALGEBRAIC) but it is the SAME guard, parameterised on sig.Name. || REFUTED: VERDICT SUSTAINED -- attacked and held. Independent re-derivation: cite.py --check 15.83.3 'Argument-1 shall be a data item of category numeric and shall not be an integer function or numeric function' -> OK rule 1; cite.py --check 8.5.2.12 'LINAGE-COUNTER' -> OK item 4, and 8.5.2.12 read in full confirms items 3/4/5 (LINE-/LINAGE-/PAGE-COUNTER) and items 6/7 (numeric / integer function), so the register admissions and the function exclusion are both correctly grounded. The guard was re-read line by line (IntrinsicBinder.cs 2197-2224) and the compound category test was hand-evaluated for both arms: numeric-edited + SMALLEST -> 'edited && sig.Name != SMALLEST' is false, '!false' is true, error raised; Category Numeric -> first conjunct false, admitted. Correct in both directions. THE EDGE THE ADJUDICATOR NEVER TESTED, now closed: 8.5.2.13 item 2 makes 'a data item described as numeric by its PICTURE character-string and described with a BLANK WHEN ZERO clause' category NUMERIC-EDITED (13.18.8.4 GR2 states the same), so PIC 999 BLANK WHEN ZERO must be REFUSED by r1 even though its picture is numeric. BlankWhenZero lives on DataItem, not on PicInfo, so the guard's pic.Category read could have missed it entirely -- but PictureAnalyzer.cs:337 retags it at analysis time ('anyEdit || (blankWhenZero && digits > 0 && !signed && usage is Usage.Display)' -> PicCategory.NumericEdited), so the item reaches BindAlgebraicFold already numeric-edited and is refused. The NATIONAL leg of 13.18.8.3 SR2 (the analyzer's arm tests only Usage.Display) is not a live hole either: PictureAnalyzer.cs:241-256 rejects EVERY numeric/numeric-edited PICTURE under USAGE NATIONAL with a loud DiagnosticCatalog.NationalData error before the retag is reached, so no legal-source national BWZ item can be constructed. Usage-only category-numeric items (8.5.2.12 item 2) reach the fold with a real PicInfo -- DataBinder.cs:2371 routes BINARY-CHAR/-SHORT/-LONG/-DOUBLE to PicInfo.BinaryItem and 2377 routes every float usage to PicInfo.FloatItem -- so the 'Pic is null' arm cannot silently reject them. Arity is gated at IntrinsicBinder.cs:573 BEFORE the Fold dispatch at 659-661, so args[0] can never be dereferenced on an empty list. No hole found; CONFORMS stands on read code, not on sampled output.
